1	# GUI Frontend
     2	
     3	The frontend is a vanilla JavaScript SPA with no build step, served as static files by the built-in HTTP server from `gui/public/`.
     4	
     5	## Architecture
     6	
     7	- **Routing:** Hash-based client-side router (`#/path`) with named parameter extraction (`:id`, `:wid`).
     8	- **Module system:** Native ES modules loaded by the browser. No bundler.
     9	- **State management:** None — every view fetches fresh data from the REST API on render. Mutations trigger a full view re-render.
    10	- **Styling:** Pico CSS (classless variant) as base layer, with a custom `styles.css` override layer using CSS custom properties. Light/dark theme switching via `data-theme` attribute on `<html>`.
    11	
    12	## Router
    13	
    14	The `Router` class (`gui/public/js/router.js`) manages view lifecycle:
    15	
    16	1. Listens for `hashchange` events.
    17	2. Matches the hash against registered patterns.
    18	3. Calls the previous view's cleanup function (if returned).
    19	4. Clears the `#app` container.
    20	5. Calls the matched view function with `(container, params)`.
    21	6. Stores any cleanup function returned by the view.
    22	
    23	## Routes
    24	
    25	| Hash Pattern | View | Description |
    26	|---|---|---|
    27	| `#/` | `dashboard.js` | Project listing with a filter/sort toolbar and a "Create Project" form. The toolbar (`.project-filter-toolbar`) sits between the page header and the project list and contains: a debounced search input (`type="search"`, ~250 ms), an optional repository filter `<select>` populated from `api.repositories.list()` (omitted if the fetch fails or returns no repos — a toast is shown on failure), and a sort `<select>` with `alpha` (Alphabetical, default) and `activity` (Last Activity) options. All three controls fire an `onFilterChange(FilterState)` callback on change. The current filter state (`{ search, repoId, sort }`) is maintained in `renderDashboard` and flows into `buildFilterToolbar`, `applyFiltersAndSort`, and `renderProjectGrid`. Filter changes re-apply the current state to the in-memory `_allProjects` cache without re-fetching; creating a new project re-fetches all project data from the API and re-applies the current filter/sort state. An empty-state message — "No projects match the current filters." vs "No projects yet." — distinguishes filtered-empty from truly-empty lists. |
    28	| `#/repositories` | `repositories.js` | Repository CRUD table. Each row's **Name** column renders as a clickable `<a class="repo-name-display repo-name-link">` element linking to `#/repositories/${encodeURIComponent(repo.id)}`. Clicking Edit switches the Name cell to an inline `<input>` for in-place editing; Save/Cancel restore the link with updated or original text. |
    29	| `#/repositories/:id` | `repository-detail.js` | Repository overview: table of every workspace across every project that contains the given repository. Each row shows Project (link to `#/projects/:pid`), Workspace (link to `#/projects/:pid/workspaces/:wid`), and the shared Branch/Status/Actions cells from `buildRepoStatusCells`. STABLE workspace rows show plain-text branch names; all other rows have a clickable branch-switch trigger. A "Refresh" button re-discovers the full project/workspace set (calls `api.projects.list()` + the full fan-out) and diffs against the existing rows: new rows are appended, removed rows are dropped, and existing rows are updated in-place via `api.status.refresh()` — protected by a `refreshInProgress` mutex. A 404 response for the repository renders a "not found" message with a link back to `#/repositories`. An empty-state message is shown when no projects contain the repository. Individual project/workspace fetch failures are handled gracefully via `Promise.allSettled` — partial results are displayed and a warning toast is shown when any fetch failed. The webserver URL is fetched once during initial load; the "Browse" button is shown only when `webserverUrl` is configured. `buildRepoStatusCells` is called with an `onError` callback (`(msg) => showToast(msg, 'error')`) so Git GUI button failures are surfaced as toasts without a dynamic `import('./toast.js')` inside the component. |
    30	| `#/projects/:id` | `project-detail.js` | Project metadata, tabbed repo/workspace/danger-zone management. The workspace table includes a **Health** column: initialized workspaces with health issues show a warning badge with issue count; healthy and uninitialized workspaces show an empty cell. Health is fetched in parallel with status for all initialized workspaces via `Promise.allSettled` (graceful degradation — fetch failures leave the health cell empty). |
    31	| `#/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid` | `workspace-detail.js` | Live git status with countdown-based polling and manual refresh. Health report fetched in parallel on initial load and on every poll/refresh cycle. Unhealthy workspaces render a `.health-alert` card with per-issue rows and fix buttons (`Regenerate File` for `regenerate-workspace-file` issues, `Fix Setup` for `setup-workspace` issues). The header management row includes an **"Open in VS Code"** button (shown only when `workspace.initialized` is `true`; dynamically inserted after a successful Setup without a full re-render). The repository status table has a 4th **"Actions"** column; each repository row contains a **"Browse"** button (shown only when `webserverUrl` is configured, opens `{webserverUrl}/{projectId}/{workspaceId}/{repoId}/` in a new tab via `window.open`) followed by a **"Git GUI"** button that calls `api.workspaces.launch.githubDesktop()`. The webserver URL is fetched once during the initial data load (in parallel with other requests) via `api.config.webserverUrl.get()`. In non-STABLE workspaces, each **Branch** cell is a clickable trigger (`<button class="branch-switch-trigger">`) that opens an inline quick-switch popover via `showBranchQuickSwitch()`. STABLE workspace branch cells remain plain text. `buildRepoStatusCells` is called with an `onError` callback so Git GUI button failures show as toasts. DOM clearing uses `clearElement()` from `utils/dom.js` throughout (no `innerHTML = ''` assignments). |
    32	| `#/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/branch-switch` | `branch-switch.js` | 3-step branch switch wizard. |
    33	| `#/settings` | `settings.js` | Settings view with three sections: **Git Credentials** (add/delete per-host PATs), **Repositories Refresh Delay** (configurable `gitPollingIntervalSeconds`), and **Webserver URL** (base URL of the local webserver; enables the "Browse" button in the workspace-detail view). All non-credentials sections share a single **"Save Settings"** footer button that calls each section's `save()` function in parallel. |
    34	| `#/error-log` | `error-log.js` | Paginated, filterable error log table with expandable detail rows and "Clear All" action. |
    35	
    36	## API Client
    37	
    38	`api.js` exports a namespaced `api` object with six groups:
    39	
    40	- `api.repositories` — `list()`, `get(id)`, `create(data)`, `update(id, data)`, `delete(id)`
    41	- `api.projects` — `list()`, `get(id)`, `create(data)`, `update(id, data)`, `rename(id, newId)`, `delete(id)`, `addRepository(pid, rid)`, `removeRepository(pid, rid)`
    42	- `api.workspaces` — `list(pid)`, `get(pid, wid)`, `create(pid, data)`, `update(pid, wid, data)`, `rename(pid, wid, newId)`, `delete(pid, wid)`, `setup(pid, wid)`, `health(pid, wid)`, `regenerateFile(pid, wid)`, `launch.vscode(pid, wid)`, `launch.githubDesktop(pid, wid, rid)`
    43	- `api.branches` — `list(pid, wid)`, `switch(pid, wid, assignments)`
    44	- `api.status` — `get(pid, wid)`, `refresh(pid, wid)`
    45	- `api.config.credentials` — `list()`, `set(data)`, `delete(host)`
    46	- `api.config.polling` — `get()`, `set(seconds)`
    47	- `api.config.webserverUrl` — `get()`, `set(url)`
    48	- `api.errorLog` — `list(params?)`, `get(id)`, `clear()`, `count()`
    49	
    50	### `api.workspaces` — Health & File Methods
    51	
    52	| Method | HTTP | Description |
    53	|---|---|---|
    54	| `health(pid, wid)` | `GET /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/health` | Fetch the health report for an initialized workspace. Returns `{ healthy: boolean, issues: Array<{ type: string, severity: string, message: string, fixAction: string, repositoryId?: string }> }`. |
    55	| `regenerateFile(pid, wid)` | `POST /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/regenerate-workspace-file` | Regenerate the `.code-workspace` file from the current repository list without cloning. Returns `{ success: boolean }`. |
    56	
    57	**`health()` issue `fixAction` values:**
    58	- `regenerate-workspace-file` — missing or stale `.code-workspace` file; surface a `Regenerate File` button.
    59	- `setup-workspace` — uncloned repository; surface a `Fix Setup` button.
    60	
    61	### `api.workspaces.launch` — External-App Launch Methods
    62	
    63	External-application launchers are grouped under the `api.workspaces.launch` sub-namespace. New launcher methods (e.g. "Open in Terminal") should be added here rather than as flat methods on `api.workspaces`.
    64	
    65	| Method | HTTP | Description |
    66	|---|---|---|
    67	| `launch.vscode(pid, wid)` | `POST /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/launch/vscode` | Open the workspace's `.code-workspace` file in VS Code. No request body. Returns `{ success: boolean }`. 400 if the workspace file does not exist on disk (run setup first). 500 on OS-level spawn failure (logged under Source: `'app-launcher'`, Operation: `'launch-vscode'`). |
    68	| `launch.githubDesktop(pid, wid, rid)` | `POST /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/launch/github-desktop/:rid` | Open a repository's local clone directory in GitHub Desktop. No request body. Returns `{ success: boolean }`. 400 if the repository directory does not exist on disk (run setup first). 500 on OS-level spawn failure (logged under Source: `'app-launcher'`, Operation: `'launch-github-desktop'`). |
    69	
    70	**Caller contract:** All path parameters (`pid`, `wid`, `rid`) are passed through `encodeURIComponent` inside `api.js`. Callers are responsible for validating that these values are not `undefined`/`null` before invoking these methods — `encodeURIComponent` will coerce them to the strings `'undefined'`/`'null'` rather than throwing.
    71	
    72	### `api.errorLog` Reference
    73	
    74	| Method | HTTP | Description |
    75	|---|---|---|
    76	| `list(params?)` | `GET /api/error-log[?...]` | Fetch error log entries with optional filtering and pagination. |
    77	| `get(id)` | `GET /api/error-log/:id` | Fetch a single entry by numeric ID. |
    78	| `clear()` | `DELETE /api/error-log` | Delete all entries. Resolves with `undefined` on HTTP 204. |
    79	| `count()` | `GET /api/error-log?limit=0` | Fetch only the total count (no entries payload). Useful for badges. |
    80	
    81	**`list()` params shape:**
    82	
    83	```js
    84	api.errorLog.list({
    85	    severity: 'error',   // optional — 'error' | 'warning'
    86	    source:   'clone',   // optional — exact-match on Source field
    87	    limit:    10,        // optional — max entries to return (default 100 server-side)
    88	    offset:   0,         // optional — zero-based page offset
    89	})
    90	```
    91	
    92	All params are optional. Omitting `params` entirely (or passing `undefined`) sends a bare `GET /api/error-log`.
    93	
    94	**`clear()` 204 contract:** The underlying `request()` helper resolves with `undefined` when the server returns HTTP 204 (no body). Callers should not try to read a response value from `clear()`.
    95	
    96	**`count()` pattern:** Sends `GET /api/error-log?limit=0`. The server returns `{ entries: [], total: N }`. Read `response.total` for the count. This is the recommended approach for polling a badge counter without transferring entry data.
    97	
    98	### `api.config.polling` Reference
    99	
   100	| Method | HTTP | Description |

1	# REST API
     2	
     3	All endpoints are served by the built-in HTTP server on `serverPort` (default `4200`). Request and response bodies are JSON. The GUI SPA is served as static files from the same server.
     4	
     5	---
     6	
     7	## Repositories
     8	
     9	| Method | Path | Success | Error Codes | Description |
    10	|---|---|---|---|---|
    11	| `GET` | `/api/repositories` | 200 | — | List all repositories. |
    12	| `GET` | `/api/repositories/:id` | 200 | 404 | Get a single repository by ID. |
    13	| `POST` | `/api/repositories` | 201 | 400 | Register a new repository. Body: `{ url, name?, id? }`. |
    14	| `PUT` | `/api/repositories/:id` | 200 | 404, 500 | Update repository metadata. Body: `{ name }`. |
    15	| `DELETE` | `/api/repositories/:id` | 204 | 404 | Delete a repository. |
    16	
    17	---
    18	
    19	## Projects
    20	
    21	| Method | Path | Success | Error Codes | Description |
    22	|---|---|---|---|---|
    23	| `GET` | `/api/projects` | 200 | — | List all projects (index entries). |
    24	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:id` | 200 | 404 | Get full project data by ID. |
    25	| `POST` | `/api/projects` | 201 | 400 | Create a new project. Body: `{ name, repositoryIds, description?, id? }`. |
    26	| `PUT` | `/api/projects/:id` | 200 | 404 | Update project metadata. Body: `{ Name?, Description? }`. |
    27	| `PUT` | `/api/projects/:id/rename` | 200 | 400, 404 | Rename project (change ID). Body: `{ newId }`. |
    28	| `DELETE` | `/api/projects/:id` | 204 | 404 | Delete project and all workspace files. |
    29	| `POST` | `/api/projects/:id/repositories` | 200 | 400, 404 | Add repository to project. Body: `{ repositoryId }`. |
    30	| `DELETE` | `/api/projects/:id/repositories/:repoId` | 204 | 404 | Remove repository from project. |
    31	
    32	---
    33	
    34	## Workspaces
    35	
    36	| Method | Path | Success | Error Codes | Description |
    37	|---|---|---|---|---|
    38	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces` | 200 | 404 | List workspaces in a project. Response includes `Initialized` boolean and `FolderPath` string. |
    39	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid` | 200 | 404 | Get a single workspace. Response includes `Initialized` boolean and `FolderPath` string. |
    40	| `POST` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces` | 201 | 400, 404 | Create workspace. Body: `{ id, description? }`. |
    41	| `PUT` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid` | 200 | 400, 404 | Update workspace. Body: `{ Description? }`. |
    42	| `PUT` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/rename` | 200 | 400, 404 | Rename workspace. Body: `{ newId }`. |
    43	| `DELETE` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid` | 204 | 404 | Delete workspace (STABLE cannot be deleted). |
    44	| `POST` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/setup` | 200 | 400, 404, 500 | Initialize workspace on disk (clone repos, generate .code-workspace file). |
    45	| `POST` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/regenerate-workspace-file` | 200 | 400, 404, 500 | Regenerate the `.code-workspace` file from the current repository list without cloning. Workspace folder must already exist on disk (400 if absent). Body: none. Response: `{ success: true }`. |
    46	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/health` | 200 | 404 | Fetch the health report for a workspace. Returns `{ healthy: boolean, issues: Array<{ type: string, severity: string, message: string, fixAction: string, repositoryId?: string }> }`. Uninitialized workspaces return `{ healthy: true, issues: [] }`. 404 if project or workspace ID is unknown. |
    47	
    48	---
    49	
    50	## Launch
    51	
    52	| Method | Path | Success | Error Codes | Description |
    53	|---|---|---|---|---|
    54	| `POST` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/launch/vscode` | 200 | 400, 404, 500 | Open the workspace's `.code-workspace` file in VS Code. 404 if the workspace is unknown. 400 with `"Workspace file does not exist. Run setup first."` if the file is missing from disk. 500 + error log entry (Source: `'app-launcher'`, Operation: `'launch-vscode'`) if the OS-level spawn fails. Response: `{ success: true }`. |
    55	| `POST` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/launch/github-desktop/:rid` | 200 | 400, 404, 500 | Open a repository directory in GitHub Desktop. 404 if the workspace, project, or repository is unknown. 400 with `"Repository directory does not exist. Run setup first."` if the repo directory is missing from disk. 500 + error log entry (Source: `'app-launcher'`, Operation: `'launch-github-desktop'`) if the OS-level spawn fails. Response: `{ success: true }`. |
    56	
    57	---
    58	
    59	## Branches
    60	
    61	| Method | Path | Success | Error Codes | Description |
    62	|---|---|---|---|---|
    63	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/branches` | 200 | 404, 500 | Get all branches per repository + suggestion list. |
    64	| `POST` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/branches/switch` | 200 | 400, 404, 500 | Switch branches. Body: `{ assignments: { [repoId]: branchName } }`. |
    65	
    66	### `GET .../branches` Response Shape
    67	
    68	```json
    69	{
    70	    "branches": {
    71	        "repo-id": [
    72	            { "name": "main", "isCurrent": true, "isRemote": false, "upstream": "origin/main" }
    73	        ]
    74	    },
    75	    "suggestions": ["main", "develop", "feature/xyz"]
    76	}
    77	```
    78	
    79	### `POST .../branches/switch` Response Shape
    80	
    81	```json
    82	{
    83	    "results": {
    84	        "repo-id": { "success": true, "conflict": false },
    85	        "other-repo": { "success": false, "conflict": true, "error": "merge conflict..." }
    86	    }
    87	}
    88	```
    89	
    90	---
    91	
    92	## Status
    93	
    94	| Method | Path | Success | Error Codes | Description |
    95	|---|---|---|---|---|
    96	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/status` | 200 | 404 | Get cached git status for all repos in workspace. |
    97	| `POST` | `/api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/status/refresh` | 200 | 404, 500 | Force-refresh git status (fetch + poll). |
    98	
    99	### `GET .../status` Response Shape

100	
   101	```json
   102	{
   103	    "repo-id": {
   104	        "currentBranch": "main",
   105	        "localCommits": 0,
   106	        "unfetchedCommits": 2,
   107	        "modifiedFiles": 3,
   108	        "lastActivity": "2026-04-08T12:00:00Z",
   109	        "hasConflicts": false
   110	    }

   112	```
   113	
   114	---
   115	
   116	## Error Log
   117	
   118	Four endpoints for reading and managing the runtime error log. The log is backed by `{storageFolder}/error-log.json` and capped at `AppConfig.maxErrorLogEntries` entries (default: 500, FIFO eviction).
   119	
   120	| Method | Path | Success | Error Codes | Description |
   121	|---|---|---|---|---|
   122	| `GET` | `/api/error-log` | 200 | — | List error log entries, newest first. Supports filtering and pagination via query params. |
   123	| `GET` | `/api/error-log/sources` | 200 | — | Return sorted distinct `Source` values in the store. |
   124	| `GET` | `/api/error-log/:id` | 200 | 400, 404 | Get a single entry by numeric ID. |
   125	| `DELETE` | `/api/error-log` | 204 | — | Clear all entries. |
   126	
   127	> **Route ordering note:** `/api/error-log/sources` is registered **before** `/api/error-log/:id` so the literal segment `"sources"` is not captured as an `:id` parameter.
   128	
   129	### `GET /api/error-log` — Query Parameters
   130	
   131	| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
   132	|---|---|---|---|
   133	| `severity` | `"error" \| "warning"` | — | Filter by severity. Any other value is silently treated as no filter. |
   134	| `source` | `string` | — | Exact-match filter on the `Source` field. No length cap or allowlist — treat as internal-use only. |
   135	| `limit` | `integer ≥ 0` | `100` | Maximum entries to return. `limit=0` returns an empty `entries` array but `total` is still populated. Negative values are clamped to 0. |
   136	| `offset` | `integer ≥ 0` | `0` | Zero-based offset into the filtered result set. Negative values are treated as 0. |
   137	
   138	> **Note on `limit=0`:** Passing `limit=0` returns `{ entries: [], total: N }`. This is intentional — it is useful for polling the current count without fetching entries. It does **not** mean "return all entries"; omit the parameter entirely to get the default 100.
   139	
   140	### `GET /api/error-log` Response Shape
   141	
   142	```json
   143	{
   144	    "entries": [
   145	        {
